name: Rotterdam The Hague Airport

runway.v: one runway, 06/24, 2,199 m long and 45 m wide

hours.v: aerodrome open 06:00-22:00 UTC in winter and 05:00-21:00 UTC in summer, i.e. 07:00-23:00 local all year

curfew.v: closed 23:00-07:00 local; positioning flights may land 06:00-07:00 local; after a delay the airport authority can allow a landing until 24:00 UTC winter / 23:00 UTC summer (01:00 local)
curfew.quote: In case of delay, permission can be granted by airport authority for landing till 2400 (2300).

slots.v: a slot is needed before arrival for aircraft over 45,000 kg MTOM or with 20 seats or more
slots.quote: All aircraft with MTOM > 45000 KG and/or equipped with >= 20 seats have to obtain a slot prior to arrival.

handling.v: ground handling is mandatory for all non-home-based general aviation and for all commercial aircraft
handling.quote: For security reasons ground handling is mandatory for all non-homebased general aviation.

max_aircraft.v: aircraft of code letter D and E need special permission from the airport authority, regardless of any slot
max_aircraft.quote: Aircraft of aerodrome reference code letter D and E require special permission from airport authority

noise.v: Chapter 2 aircraft and noisy Chapter 3 aircraft are not allowed
noise.quote: Chapter 2 aircraft and noisy Chapter 3 aircraft are not allowed.

fuel.v: Jet A-1 and Avgas 100LL; Jet A-1 for general aviation Mon-Fri 05:00-22:00 UTC (04:00-21:00 summer), weekends 05:00-21:00 UTC (04:00-20:00 summer)
fuel.quote: Fuel: JET A-1, AVGAS 100LL, Liquid hydrogen

notes: Read: Netherlands eAIP AD 2 EHRD, AIRAC AMDT 06-2026 (11 Jun 2026), the latest edition that could be opened; a later amendment (AMDT 08-2026, 6 Aug 2026, exists per its chart files) could not be opened (fetch not permitted), so check for changes. Times read as UTC with summer times in brackets (Dutch AIP convention; GEN 2.1 not read). PPR in AD 2.20 applies only to training flights over 2,000 kg, so not recorded as a general rule.
